title: C: Feature Flags
description: Implement a feature flag system with a hash table that stores boolean toggles for named features.

steps.title: Feature Flag System
steps.description: Define a simple feature flag store: a fixed-size array of (name, enabled) pairs. Write `void ff_set(char *name, int val)` to set a flag, `int ff_get(char *name)` to check if a flag is enabled, and `void ff_list()` to print all flags. Test with 3 flags.
hints: Use a simple linear search through the flag array.
Max 20 flags, each with a name and int (0/1).
ff_list prints all flags and their status.

verification.failureMessage: Set flags and list them with their status
